## Data prepration
concatenate FASTQ files from two separate years (2025 and 2026) for each of the two strains.
```{bash}
cat data/WA.fastq data/WA_2026.fastq > data/WA_final.fastq
cat data/U.fastq data/HU_2026.fastq > data/HU_final.fastq
```

## Quality assessment (sequali)
```{bash}
conda init
conda activate sequali-env
sequali --outdir outputs/WAsequali_reports/ data/WA_final.fastq
sequali --outdir outputs/HUsequali_reports/ data/HU_final.fastq
```

## Filtering files (Filtlong)
```{bash}
conda init
conda activate filtlong_env
filtlong --keep_percent 75 data/WA_final.fastq > outputs/filtered_files/WA_filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq
filtlong --keep_percent 75 data/Hu_final.fastq > outputs/filtered_files/HU_filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq
```

## Sequali on filtered files
```{bash}
conda init
conda activate sequali-env
sequali --outdir outputs/sequali_filtered_files/ outputs/filtered_files/WA_filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq
sequali --outdir outputs/sequali_filtered_files/ outputs/filtered_files/HU_filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq
```

## Genome assembly (flye)
```{bash}
flye --nano-raw outputs/filtered_files/WA_filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq --out-dir outputs/assembly/WA_flye_output --threads 8 --genome-size 12m
flye --nano-raw outputs/filtered_files/HU_filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq --out-dir outputs/assembly/HU_flye_output --threads 8 --genome-size 12m
```

## Polishing assembly (medaka)
### Two rounds of medaka polishing for W.anomalus
```{bash}
medaka_consensus -i data/WA_final.fastq -d outputs/assembly/WA_flye_output/assembly.fasta -o outputs/medaka_round1/WA -t 8
medaka_consensus -i data/WA_final.fastq -d outputs/medaka_round1/WA/consensus.fasta -o outputs/medaka_round2/WA -t 8
```

### two rounds of medaka polishing for H.uvarum
```{bash}
medaka_consensus -i data/HU_final.fastq -d outputs/assembly/HU_flye_output/assembly.fasta -o outputs/medaka_round1/HU -t 8
medaka_consensus -i data/HU_final.fastq -d outputs/medaka_round1/HU/consensus.fasta -o outputs/medaka_round2/HU -t 8
```

## Assembly analysis (QUAST and BUSCO)
### Using QUAST (without Reference sequence) for W.anomalus
```{bash}
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/data \
-w/data quay.io/biocontainers/quast:5.3.0--py313pl5321h5ca1c30_2 \
quast.py outputs/medaka_round2/WA/consensus.fasta \
-o outputs/QUAST_assembly_analysis/WA
```

### Using QUAST (without Reference sequence) for H.uvarum
```{bash}
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/data \
-w/data quay.io/biocontainers/quast:5.3.0--py313pl5321h5ca1c30_2 \
quast.py outputs/medaka_round2/HU/consensus.fasta \
-o outputs/QUAST_assembly_analysis/HU
```

```{bash}
quast.py outputs/medaka_round2/WA/consensus.fasta \
-r data/WA_ref.fna \
-o outputs/QUAST_assembly_analysis/WA_ref
```

### Using QUAST (with reference sequence) for H.uvarum
```{bash}
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/data -w /data quay.io/biocontainers/quast:5.3.0--py313pl5321h5ca1c30_2 \
quast.py outputs/medaka_round2/HU/consensus.fasta \
-r data/HU_ref.fna \

```

### Using BUSCO for W.anomalus
```{bash}
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/data \
-w /data ezlabgva/busco:v6.0.0_cv1 \
busco -i outputs/medaka_round2/WA/consensus.fasta \
-o outputs/busco_output/WA \
--auto-lineage-euk \
```


## Funannotate
### Pull Docker image
```{bash}
docker pull nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15
```

### Install correct busco database
```{bash}
docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v "$PWD":/data -e FUNANNOTATE_DB=/data/funannotate_db nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15 funannotate setup -i busco -b saccharomycetes -d /data/funannotate_db

# check if database installed
docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 \
-v "$PWD":/data -w /data \
-e FUNANNOTATE_DB=/data/funannotate_db \
nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15 \
funannotate database --show-versions

# Inspect lineage contents
docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 \
-v "$PWD":/data -w /data \
-e FUNANNOTATE_DB=/data/funannotate_db \
nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15 \
bash -c 'ls -lah /data/funannotate_db && find /data/funannotate_db -iname "*saccharomycetes*"'

# check if Saccharomycetes BUSCO lineage is populated
docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 \
-v "$PWD":/data \
-e FUNANNOTATE_DB=/data/funannotate_db \
nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15 \
bash -c 'ls -lah /data/funannotate_db/saccharomycetes'
```

### Using Funannotate for W.anomalus
```{bash}
# Define reusable variables
IMAGE="nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15"
PLATFORM="--platform linux/amd64"
CPUS=8
INPUT="outputs/medaka_round2/WA/consensus.fasta"
SPECIES="Wickerhamomyces anomalus"   
STRAIN="NK1"      

# Step 1: Clean redundant/short contigs ("genomic dust")
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
funannotate clean \
-i $INPUT \
-o outputs/funannotate/WA/assembly_clean.fasta

# Step 2: Sort contigs by length and standardize header names (scaffold_1, etc.)
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
funannotate sort \
-i outputs/funannotate/WA/assembly_clean.fasta \
-o outputs/funannotate/WA/assembly_sorted.fasta

# Step 3: Soft-mask repetitive elements
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
funannotate mask \
-i  outputs/funannotate/WA/assembly_sorted.fasta \
-o outputs/funannotate/WA/assembly_masked.fasta \
--cpus $CPUS

# Step 4: Predict gene models using Saccharomycetes BUSCO models for training
docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -u 0:0 \
-v "$PWD":/data -w /data \
-e FUNANNOTATE_DB=/data/funannotate_db \
nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15 \
funannotate predict \
-i outputs/funannotate/WA/assembly_masked.fasta \
-o outputs/funannotate_out/WA_prediction_corrected \
-s "Wickerhamomyces anomalus" \
--strain "NK1" \
--busco_db saccharomycetes \
--cpus 8
```

## eggNOG-mapper via conda
### Installing eggNOG-mapper
Create a dedicated Conda environment to install eggNOG-mapper and its fast sequence aligner (diamond)
```{bash}
conda create -n eggnog_env -c conda-forge -c bioconda python=3.10 eggnog-mapper
```

### Running eggNOG-mapper
Activate your Conda environment and run emapper.py on your *.proteins.fa file
```{bash}
eval "$(conda shell.bash hook)"
conda activate eggnog_env

EGGNOG_DB_PATH="$HOME/Desktop/eggnog_db"

emapper.py \
 -i outputs/funannotate_out/WA_prediction/predict_results/Wickerhamomyces_anomalus_NK1.proteins.fa \
  --output WA_functional \
  --output_dir outputs/egg_out/WA \
  --data_dir $EGGNOG_DB_PATH \
  --decorate_gff yes \
  --excel \
  -m diamond \
  --cpu 8
```

```{bash}
eval "$(conda shell.bash hook)"
conda activate eggnog_env

EGGNOG_DB_PATH="$HOME/Desktop/eggnog_db"

emapper.py \
 -i outputs/funannotate_out/HU_prediction/predict_results/Hanseniaspora_uvarum_AD.proteins.fa \
  --output HU_functional \
  --output_dir outputs/egg_out/HU \
  --data_dir $EGGNOG_DB_PATH \
  --decorate_gff yes \
  --excel \
  -m diamond \
  --cpu 8
```
  
## Interpreting funannotate results
### Loading required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(GO.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

## Checking eggNOG annotatio for W.anomalus
### Read eggNOG annotations
```{r}
eggnog_data <- read_tsv(
  "outputs/egg_out/WA/WA_functional.emapper.annotations",
  comment = "##",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_remove(.x, "^#"))

# 2. Search protein descriptions and preferred names
voc_candidates <- eggnog_data %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      str_to_lower(paste(Preferred_name, Description)),
      "acetyltransferase|eat1|ester|alcohol dehydrogenase|aldehyde dehydrogenase|acetyl-coa|pyruvate|aminotransferase|decarboxylase"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    query,
    Preferred_name,
    Description,
    EC,
    KEGG_ko,
    KEGG_Pathway,
    PFAMs
  ) %>%
  distinct()

print(voc_candidates, n = 30)
```

### save results
```{r}
write_csv(voc_candidates, "outputs/egg_out/results/WA_VOC_candidate_genes.csv")
```

```{r}
capture.output(
  print(voc_candidates, n = Inf),
  file = "outputs/egg_out/results/WA_VOC_candidate_genes.txt"
)
```

### Using ggplot2 (graph1)
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(GO.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# Combine both isolates
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  WA = eggnog_data,
  HU = hu_data,
  .id = "Isolate"
)

# Extract GO terms
go_long <- combined_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(GOs), GOs != "-") %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",")

go_lookup <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(go_long$GOs),
  columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY"),
  keytype = "GOID"
)

go_annotated <- left_join(
  go_long,
  go_lookup,
  by = c("GOs" = "GOID")
)

voc_go <- go_annotated %>%
  filter(
    ONTOLOGY == "BP",
    str_detect(
      str_to_lower(TERM),
      "ester biosynthetic process|ester metabolic process|alcohol biosynthetic process|alcohol metabolic process|aldehyde biosynthetic process|aldehyde metabolic process|acetyl-coa metabolic process|acetyl-coa biosynthetic process|pyruvate metabolic process|branched-chain amino acid metabolic process|organic acid metabolic process"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(Isolate, query, TERM)

voc_go_counts <- voc_go %>%
  count(TERM, Isolate)

voc_plot <- ggplot(
  voc_go_counts,
  aes(x = reorder(TERM, n), y = n, fill = Isolate)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "WA" = "#2878B5",
      "HU" = "#269B8A"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "VOC-Related Biological Processes in WA and HU",
    x = "Biological Process",
    y = "Number of Annotated Genes",
    fill = "Isolate"
  ) 
  
voc_plot

# save the plot
ggsave(filename = "outputs/results_figs/WA_HU_VOC_GO.png",
       plot = voc_plot,
       width = 12,
       height = 7,
       dpi = 300,
       bg="white")
```

### Using ggplot2 (graph2)
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)

# 1. Define the order of functional categories
category_order <- c(
  "Sugar breakdown",
  "Fermentation",
  "Alcohol production and metabolism",
  "Aldehyde metabolism",
  "Aroma compound building blocks",
  "Amino acid breakdown",
  "Fat and lipid metabolism"
)

# 2. Count genes in each GO category for each isolate
# Rename WA and HU using the full species names
go_category_counts <- voc_go_grouped %>%
  mutate(
    Isolate = case_when(
      Isolate == "WA" ~ "W. anomalus (NK1)",
      Isolate == "HU" ~ "H. uvarum (AD)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Isolate)) %>%
  count(GO_category, Isolate, name = "n_genes")

# 3. Set category and isolate order
go_category_counts <- go_category_counts %>%
  mutate(
    GO_category = factor(
      GO_category,
      levels = category_order
    ),
    Isolate = factor(
      Isolate,
      levels = c("W. anomalus (NK1)", "H. uvarum (AD)")
    )
  )

# 4. Check the count table before plotting
print(go_category_counts, n = Inf)

# 5. Create the grouped bar graph
voc_plot <- ggplot(
  go_category_counts,
  aes(
    x = GO_category,
    y = n_genes,
    fill = Isolate
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n_genes),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "W. anomalus (NK1)" = "#2878B5",
      "H. uvarum (AD)" = "#269B8A"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "W. anomalus (NK1)",
      "H. uvarum (AD)"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "W. anomalus (NK1)" = "<i>W. anomalus</i> (NK1)",
      "H. uvarum (AD)" = "<i>H. uvarum</i> (AD)"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 22)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Functional Categories Associated with VOC-Related Metabolism",
    subtitle = "Comparison of biological process annotations between two yeast isolates",
    x = "Metabolic Functional Category",
    y = "Number of Annotated Genes",
    fill = "Yeast Isolate",
    caption = paste(
      "Selected GO biological process terms were grouped into broader functional categories.",
      "Counts represent predicted protein annotations, not gene expression or measured VOC production."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      color = "grey30"
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "grey30",
      hjust = 0
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# 6. Display the graph
voc_plot

# 7. Save the graph at poster resolution
ggsave(
  filename = "outputs/results_figs/WA_HU_VOC_GO_poster.png",
  plot = voc_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# 8. Export the count table
write_csv(
  go_category_counts,
  "outputs/results_figs/WA_HU_VOC_GO_category_counts.csv"
)

```

### Ester-biosynthesis candidates
```{r}
# ============================================================
# COMPARATIVE ESTER-BIOSYNTHESIS CANDIDATE ANALYSIS
# WA: Wickerhamomyces anomalus NK1
# HU: Hanseniaspora uvarum AD
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)

# 1. Combine annotations from both isolates
combined_candidates <- bind_rows(
  WA = eggnog_data,
  HU = hu_data,
  .id = "Isolate"
)

# 2. Search for potential ester-related enzymes
ester_candidates <- combined_candidates %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      str_to_lower(
        paste(
          coalesce(Preferred_name, ""),
          coalesce(Description, "")
        )
      ),
      "eat1|eath|alcohol acetyltransferase|ethanol acetyltransferase|ester biosynthesis|ester synthase|acetyltransferase|esterase"
    )
  ) %>%
dplyr::select(
    Isolate,
    query,
    Preferred_name,
    Description,
    EC,
    KEGG_ko,
    KEGG_Pathway,
    PFAMs
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# 3. Classify candidate enzymes
ester_candidates <- ester_candidates %>%
  mutate(
    Annotation_text = str_to_lower(
      paste(
        coalesce(Preferred_name, ""),
        coalesce(Description, "")
      )
    ),

    Enzyme_Category = case_when(
      str_detect(Annotation_text, "eat1|eath") ~
        "Eat1/EatH-like annotations",

      str_detect(
        Annotation_text,
        "alcohol acetyltransferase|ethanol acetyltransferase"
      ) ~ "Alcohol acetyltransferases",

      str_detect(Annotation_text, "esterase") ~
        "Esterases",

      str_detect(
        Annotation_text,
        "ester biosynthesis|ester synthase"
      ) ~ "Other ester-related enzymes",

      str_detect(Annotation_text, "acetyltransferase") ~
        "Other acetyltransferases",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
dplyr::select(-Annotation_text)

# 4. Display candidate gene annotations
cat("\nESTER-RELATED CANDIDATE GENES\n")

print(ester_candidates, n = Inf)

# 5. Count candidates by isolate and enzyme category
ester_candidate_counts <- ester_candidates %>%
  count(Isolate, Enzyme_Category, name = "Gene_Count")

cat("\nCANDIDATE GENE COUNTS\n")

print(ester_candidate_counts, n = Inf)

# 6. Set category order
enzyme_order <- c(
  "Eat1/EatH-like annotations",
  "Alcohol acetyltransferases",
  "Other ester-related enzymes",
  "Other acetyltransferases",
  "Esterases"
)

# 7. Prepare data for plotting
ester_candidate_counts <- ester_candidate_counts %>%
  mutate(
    Enzyme_Category = factor(
      Enzyme_Category,
      levels = enzyme_order
    ),
    Isolate = factor(
      Isolate,
      levels = c("WA", "HU"),
      labels = c(
        "W. anomalus (NK1)",
        "H. uvarum (AD)"
      )
    )
  )

# 8. Create grouped bar graph
ester_plot <- ggplot(
  ester_candidate_counts,
  aes(
    x = Enzyme_Category,
    y = Gene_Count,
    fill = Isolate
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Gene_Count),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "W. anomalus (NK1)" = "#2878B5",
      "H. uvarum (AD)" = "#269B8A"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "W. anomalus (NK1)" = "<i>W. anomalus</i> (NK1)",
      "H. uvarum (AD)" = "<i>H. uvarum</i> (AD)"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 22)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Ester-Related Enzyme Candidates",
    subtitle = "Comparative functional annotation of two yeast isolates",
    x = "Candidate Enzyme Category",
    y = "Number of Annotated Proteins",
    fill = "Yeast Isolate",
    caption = paste(
      "Candidates identified through eggNOG annotation keyword screening.",
      "Counts do not confirm enzyme activity or actual ester production.",
      "Eat1/EatH-like annotations require sequence-level validation."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "grey30",
      hjust = 0
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 25,
      hjust = 1,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# 9. Display graph
print(ester_plot)

# 10. Create output directory if necessary
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# 11. Save graph
ggsave(
  filename = "outputs/WA_HU_ester_candidate_comparison.png",
  plot = ester_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# 12. Export candidate gene table
write_csv(
  ester_candidates,
  "outputs/WA_HU_ester_biosynthesis_candidates.csv"
)

# 13. Export candidate count table
write_csv(
  ester_candidate_counts,
  "outputs/WA_HU_ester_candidate_counts.csv"
)

cat("\nAnalysis completed. Files saved in outputs/.\n")
```
### Using heatmap
```{r}

library(tidyverse)

# 1. Combine candidate annotations
combined_candidates <- bind_rows(
  WA = voc_candidates,
  HU = hu_candidates,
  .id = "Isolate"
)

# 2. Assign functional gene categories
voc_heatmap_data <- combined_candidates %>%
  mutate(
    Annotation = str_to_lower(paste(Preferred_name, Description)),
    Gene_Category = case_when(
      str_detect(Annotation, "eat1|eath|alcohol acetyltransferase|acetyltransferase") ~
        "Alcohol acetyltransferases",
      str_detect(Annotation, "alcohol dehydrogenase") ~
        "Alcohol dehydrogenases",
      str_detect(Annotation, "aldehyde dehydrogenase") ~
        "Aldehyde dehydrogenases",
      str_detect(Annotation, "aminotransferase") ~
        "Aminotransferases",
      str_detect(Annotation, "decarboxylase") ~
        "Decarboxylases",
      str_detect(Annotation, "acetyl-coa") ~
        "Acetyl-CoA-related enzymes",
      str_detect(Annotation, "esterase|ester") ~
        "Ester-related enzymes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gene_Category)) %>%
  distinct(Isolate, query, Gene_Category)

# 3. Count candidate genes per category and isolate
heatmap_counts <- voc_heatmap_data %>%
  count(Gene_Category, Isolate) %>%
  complete(
    Gene_Category,
    Isolate = c("WA", "HU"),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  )

# 4. Create heatmap
heatmap_plot <- ggplot(
  heatmap_counts,
  aes(x = Isolate, y = Gene_Category, fill = n)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#F5F0FA",
    high = "#68428A",
    name = "Gene count"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "WA" = expression(italic("W. anomalus")),
    "HU" = expression(italic("H. uvarum"))
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of VOC-Related Candidate Genes",
    subtitle = expression(
      "Functional annotation of " *
        italic("W. anomalus") * " and " *
        italic("H. uvarum") * " yeast isolates"
    ),
    x = "Yeast Isolate",
    y = "Functional Gene Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# 5. Display heatmap
heatmap_plot

# 6. Save high-resolution image
ggsave(
  "outputs/WA_HU_VOC_candidate_heatmap.png",
  plot = heatmap_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

```

## Build an Annotation eveidence table
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

combined_data <- bind_rows(
  WA = eggnog_data,
  HU = hu_data,
  .id = "Isolate"
)

voc_evidence <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    Annotation = str_to_lower(
      paste(Preferred_name, Description, EC, KEGG_ko, PFAMs)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      Annotation,
      "eat1|eath|ethyl acetate|isoamyl acetate|phenylethanol|phenyl ethanol|butyl acetate|ethyl hexanoate|acetate biosynthesis|alcohol acetyltransferase|ester biosynthesis"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Isolate,
    query,
    Preferred_name,
    Description,
    EC,
    KEGG_ko,
    KEGG_Pathway,
    PFAMs
  ) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(
  voc_evidence,
  "outputs/VOC_annotation_evidence.csv"
)

View(voc_evidence)
```
